recentItems.title: Andrew Garfield on Finding Out He Was Playing Spider-Man, New Film The Uprising & Playing Sam Altman
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Jimmy Kimmel Recaps Trump’s Crazy Summer, Our Country Still Being a Mess & Our 4,000th Show
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Jelly Roll Speaks His Truth
recentItems.description:
Jelly Roll talks about his last night guest hosting the show, making it on to “Jeopardy,” Jimmy asking him to fill in for him, people saying he's now a mouthpiece for all the left-wing lunatics in Hollywood, talking heads on cable news overreacting to the jokes in his monologues, having a great time working with our staff and crew, and he takes a moment to get serious and talk about the night he won three Grammys, getting asked a question and fumbling his words immediately after, being able to vote now, trying to be a voice for the voiceless, the importance of human dignity and compassion, the American Dream being for all people, his faith, his late father being a veteran of the United States Marine Corp, meeting the President, and people on different ends of the political spectrum coming together and being friends.
